parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: This is one leg of the pliers, made of steel, forming one of the two lever arms of the tool.
parts.Functional_description: It provides leverage and transmits force from the handle to the jaws for gripping or cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint relative to the other leg to open and close the jaws.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the pliers, including the handle area, typically made of steel with a rubber coating for grip.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main structure and handle for the pliers, allowing the user to apply force comfortably.
parts.Movement_description: It acts as one of the two main arms that pivot around the joint, moving in coordination with the other leg.
